name: MSF-Docker
description: MSF Docker is a free, open-source, TUN-only DNS and proxy gateway that manages MosDNS and Mihomo through one WebUI. The recommended Unraid deployment gives the container a dedicated LAN IPv4 address on br0.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent MSF configuration, components, databases, and logs.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: MSF WebUI port. Keep 7777 when using a custom br0 address.

variables.name: Runtime
variables.description: Identifies this installation as a Docker runtime.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Persistent data directory inside the container.

variables.name: Docker Network Mode
variables.description: MSF TUN networking mode for an Unraid custom LAN address.

variables.name: Network Cleanup
variables.description: Keep host and container networking intact when MSF exits.

devices.name: TUN Device
devices.description: Pass the host TUN device into the container.
